sources.title: GODELEV/Rose-Mini · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Rose X1 is a lightweight decoder-only architecture designed around one simple philosophy: Extract more capability from fewer parameters. Instead of chasing larger parameter counts, Rose focuses on architectural efficiency and better utilization of compute.
